name: address-geocoder

description.en: The storefront turns the pin a guest drops into a street address with Nominatim, within its usage policy.
description.uk: Вітрина перетворює точку, яку ставить гість, на адресу через Nominatim у межах його правил використання.

external.api_version: Nominatim API /reverse, format=jsonv2; usage policy: max 1 req/s, identifying User-Agent, no bulk

probe: One reverse lookup per run, identifying UA, <= 3 req/run at <= 1/s; licence names OSM; display_name present; live CSP connect-src names nominatim. MEASURED: 200, place_id 57009419.
